value.rationale: Sun explicitly posed the same quantified strict prime-count root monotonicity as Conjecture 2.7(i) in 2014. The proof resolves that entire conjecture by integrating explicit short-interval estimates with an exact finite endpoint certificate, rather than proving a routine finite special case. Its value is the complete unconditional statement; part (ii) is not implied.
